_note: Two-plane decomposition for Kim's three 2026-10-03 corpus rulings (GH #1730 multi-turn facet, GH #1733 repair facet, GH #1736 surface lifecycle under ADR-0064 cl.4). OUTSIDE-IN nodes = the records and build slices the rulings produce. INSIDE-OUT actions = what each ruling must make true, each a checkable predicate. plan:true, so every leaf carries its accept. The two design leaves (ADR-0231, the ADR-0064 amendment) are authored by the planner seat in this change; the four build leaves are filed as GitHub Issues (label task) and dispatched to a2ui-build-agent after the docs land.

nodes.label: the three rulings recorded as decision records
ADR-0231: multi-turn + repair facets (record shape, validation, admission, verdict, rubric, exemplar non-regression)
nodes.accept: `npx vitest run site/lib/adr.test.ts site/lib/docs-grammar.test.ts site/lib/sitemap.test.ts` exits 0 with the new file present; `node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs` leaves `git diff --exit-code site/public/adr-index.json` clean; doc-checker handback filed with every substantive finding fixed

nodes.label: ADR-0064 cl.4 amendment: id-graph reset on deleteSurface, single-surface holds, trigger re-armed
nodes.accept: same three vitest gates exit 0; the amendment is an appended `## Amendment` section and `git diff` shows zero changed lines above it in 0064

slice: facet schema + validator + admit + store + rubric 1.3 (record.ts/admit.ts/store.ts/canonical.ts/retrieve.ts/corpus-data.test.ts/examples types/import-seeds)
nodes.accept: `npm run check` and `npm test` exit 0; `validateRecord` accepts a conforming multi-turn and a conforming repair record and rejects each ADR-0231 negative control at its named path; the 74-line exemplar shard re-admits with byte-identical `canonicalHash` for every line

nodes.label: slice: 2 multi-turn seeds (form submit, list item select) admitted with a judged VerdictsFile
nodes.accept: `corpus/multi-turn/v1_0/agent-ui.jsonl` holds >= 2 lines; `npm test` exits 0 with the new shard under the standing gate; the follow-up of each record validates clean ONLY with the prior-derived seed (standalone it fails `sid:root-missing`), proven by a test

nodes.label: slice: 5 repair pairs over the top shared-validator error codes admitted with a judged VerdictsFile
nodes.accept: `corpus/repair/v1_0/agent-ui.jsonl` holds >= 5 lines whose `validatorErrors` code sets cover >= 3 distinct `ErrorCode`s; the standing gate recomputes each record's `validatorErrors` and finds set-equality; `npm test` exits 0

nodes.label: slice: validator + canonicalizer free a surface's id graph at deleteSurface (epochs)
nodes.accept: `validate-payload.ts` on the #1736 probe (createSurface s, root, deleteSurface s, createSurface s, root) exits 0; a create+delete+create with an EMPTY second epoch fails `s:root-missing` at finalize; `canonicalize` of every existing shard line is byte-identical (74 hashes unchanged); `npm run check` and `npm test` exit 0
